query_text: What cookware brands do professional chefs use? List several.
response_text:
# Professional Chef Cookware Brands

Here are cookware brands commonly used by professional chefs:

## Premium/Professional Brands
- **All-Clad** - Industry standard for stainless steel cookware
- **Mauviel** - French copper cookware
- **Matfer Bourgeat** - French professional kitchen equipment
- **Vollrath** - Commercial kitchen staple
- **Tramontina** - Professional line offers great value

## Cast Iron & Carbon Steel
- **Lodge** - Affordable, reliable cast iron
- **Le Creuset** - High-end enameled cast iron
- **Staub** - Premium enameled cookware
- **de Buyer** - French carbon steel pans

## Restaurant Supply Favorites
- **Winco** - Budget-friendly restaurant supply
- **Update International** - Commercial grade
- **Carlisle** - Institutional cookware

## Specialty/High-End
- **Demeyere** - Belgian precision cookware
- **Hestan** - Used in culinary schools
- **Ruffoni** - Italian copper artisan pieces

Many professional chefs mix brands based on specific needs rather than using one exclusively. All-Clad stainless, carbon steel pans, and basic restaurant supply aluminum are particularly common in professional kitchens.
